+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;
+  if (connect != null && connect.$1 < windowStory.window) {
+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }
+  return AssistantMessage(
+    content: const [],
+    api: model.api,
+    provider: model.provider,
+    model: model.id,
+    usage: Usage.zero,
+    stopReason: StopReason.error,
+    errorMessage:
+        'Provider zero-byte stall after ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s) '
+        'over $elapsedText — the endpoint accepted the request but never '
+        'produced output; the run-idle watchdog killed every silent '
+        'attempt ($zeroByteStallTag). Attempts: $log. $windowNote To wait '
+        'longer on a warming-up model, raise '
+        'providerTimeouts.streamIdleTimeoutMs. The failure is '
+        'retryable: a fallback model may take over, or check the '
+        'provider status / try again later.',
+    timestamp: DateTime.now(),
+  );
+}

+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });

+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.

+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).

+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.

+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';

+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;

+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;

+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;

+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}

+) {

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.

+      '(${windowStory.source}).';

+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;

+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}

+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog

+ErrorEvent _zeroByteStallTerminal(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) => ErrorEvent(
+  reason: StopReason.error,
+  error: _zeroByteStallMessage(model, attemptLog, startedAt, windowStory),
+);
+
+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;
+  if (connect != null && connect.$1 < windowStory.window) {
+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }
+  return AssistantMessage(
+    content: const [],
+    api: model.api,
+    provider: model.provider,
+    model: model.id,
+    usage: Usage.zero,
+    stopReason: StopReason.error,
+    errorMessage:
+        'Provider zero-byte stall after ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s) '
+        'over $elapsedText — the endpoint accepted the request but never '
+        'produced output; the run-idle watchdog killed every silent '
+        'attempt ($zeroByteStallTag). Attempts: $log. $windowNote To wait '
+        'longer on a warming-up model, raise '
+        'providerTimeouts.streamIdleTimeoutMs. The failure is '
+        'retryable: a fallback model may take over, or check the '
+        'provider status / try again later.',
+    timestamp: DateTime.now(),
+  );
+}","oldText":"","path":"lib/src/providers/transient_retry_stream.dart"}

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';

+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.

+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.

+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;
+  if (connect != null && connect.$1 < windowStory.window) {
+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }
+  return AssistantMessage(
+    content: const [],
+    api: model.api,
+    provider: model.provider,
+    model: model.id,

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;
+  if (connect != null && connect.$1 < windowStory.window) {
+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }

+ErrorEvent _zeroByteStallTerminal(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,

+) => ErrorEvent(
+  reason: StopReason.error,
+  error: _zeroByteStallMessage(model, attemptLog, startedAt, windowStory),
+);
+
+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;
+  if (connect != null && connect.$1 < windowStory.window) {
+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }
+  return AssistantMessage(
+    content: const [],
+    api: model.api,
+    provider: model.provider,
+    model: model.id,
+    usage: Usage.zero,
+    stopReason: StopReason.error,
+    errorMessage:
+        'Provider zero-byte stall after ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s) '
+        'over $elapsedText — the endpoint accepted the request but never '
+        'produced output; the run-idle watchdog killed every silent '
+        'attempt ($zeroByteStallTag). Attempts: $log. $windowNote To wait '
+        'longer on a warming-up model, raise '
+        'providerTimeouts.streamIdleTimeoutMs. The failure is '
+        'retryable: a fallback model may take over, or check the '
+        'provider status / try again later.',

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;
+  if (connect != null && connect.$1 < windowStory.window) {
+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');

+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a

+ErrorEvent _zeroByteStallTerminal(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) => ErrorEvent(
+  reason: StopReason.error,
+  error: _zeroByteStallMessage(model, attemptLog, startedAt, windowStory),
+);
+
+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;
+  if (connect != null && connect.$1 < windowStory.window) {
+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }
+  return AssistantMessage(
+    content: const [],
+    api: model.api,
+    provider: model.provider,
+    model: model.id,
+    usage: Usage.zero,
+    stopReason: StopReason.error,
+    errorMessage:
+        'Provider zero-byte stall after ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s) '
+        'over $elapsedText — the endpoint accepted the request but never '
+        'produced output; the run-idle watchdog killed every silent '
+        'attempt ($zeroByteStallTag). Attempts: $log. $windowNote To wait '
+        'longer on a warming-up model, raise '
+        'providerTimeouts.streamIdleTimeoutMs. The failure is '
+        'retryable: a fallback model may take over, or check the '
+        'provider status / try again later.',
+    timestamp: DateTime.now(),
+  );

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;

+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );

+    required this.source,

+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+

+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,

+  reason: StopReason.error,
+  error: _zeroByteStallMessage(model, attemptLog, startedAt, windowStory),
+);
+
+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;
+  if (connect != null && connect.$1 < windowStory.window) {
+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }
+  return AssistantMessage(
+    content: const [],
+    api: model.api,
+    provider: model.provider,
+    model: model.id,
+    usage: Usage.zero,
+    stopReason: StopReason.error,
+    errorMessage:
+        'Provider zero-byte stall after ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s) '
+        'over $elapsedText — the endpoint accepted the request but never '
+        'produced output; the run-idle watchdog killed every silent '
+        'attempt ($zeroByteStallTag). Attempts: $log. $windowNote To wait '
+        'longer on a warming-up model, raise '
+        'providerTimeouts.streamIdleTimeoutMs. The failure is '
+        'retryable: a fallback model may take over, or check the '
+        'provider status / try again later.',
+    timestamp: DateTime.now(),
+  );

+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });

+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;

+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {

+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';

+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.

+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+

+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(

+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;

+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }

+/// Where the zero-byte attempts' patience came from (gh-1617 AC4/AC5):
+/// the governing idle window + its precedence source, and the explicit
+/// connect budget when one clipped the replay.
+final class _ZeroByteWindowStory {
+  const _ZeroByteWindowStory({
+    required this.window,
+    required this.source,
+    this.connectBudget,
+  });
+
+  /// The idle window the watchdog kills ran under: the fire's own
+  /// duration (the interval the agent armed — the derived window),
+  /// else the model's explicit window, else the provider default.
+  final Duration window;
+
+  /// The rendered precedence source (`role <role> override` /
+  /// `provider:<name>` / `global` / `default`).
+  final String source;
+
+  /// The explicitly configured connect budget, when one is (AC4).
+  final (Duration, String)? connectBudget;
+}
+
+/// Resolves the window story for a zero-byte verdict (gh-1617): the
+/// watchdog interval that actually killed the attempts wins ([fireWindow]
+/// — the fire carries the agent's derived window), falling back to the
+/// gh-1554 precedence and then the provider default for direct-ladder
+/// callers whose cancel reason carries no duration.
+_ZeroByteWindowStory _zeroByteWindowStory(
+  Model model,
+  Duration? fireWindow,
+) {
+  final explicit = explicitStreamIdleForModel(model);
+  final window = fireWindow ?? explicit?.$1 ?? providerStreamIdleTimeout;
+  return _ZeroByteWindowStory(
+    window: window,
+    source: explicit?.$2 ?? 'default',
+    connectBudget: explicitConnectForModel(model),
+  );
+}
+
+/// The zero-byte stall story (see [_zeroByteStallTerminal]).
+AssistantMessage _zeroByteStallMessage(
+  Model model,
+  List<String> attemptLog,
+  DateTime startedAt,
+  _ZeroByteWindowStory windowStory,
+) {
+  final elapsed = DateTime.now().difference(startedAt);
+  final elapsedText = elapsed.inSeconds < 1 ? '<1s' : '${elapsed.inSeconds}s';
+  final log = attemptLog
+      .map(
+        (line) =>
+            line.endsWith('.') ? line.substring(0, line.length - 1) : line,
+      )
+      .join('; ');
+  // gh-1617 AC5: the terminal names the effective window and its
+  // precedence source, and suggests raising streamIdleTimeoutMs for a
+  // genuinely warming-up model.
+  var windowNote =
+      'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+      '(${windowStory.source}).';
+  // gh-1617 AC4: a connect budget below the window stopped the replay —
+  // both values are named so the config conflict is readable at a glance.
+  final connect = windowStory.connectBudget;
+  if (connect != null && connect.$1 < windowStory.window) {
+    windowNote =
+        'Idle window ${formatProviderTimeout(windowStory.window)} '
+        '(${windowStory.source}); the configured connectTimeoutMs '
+        '${formatProviderTimeout(connect.$1)} (${connect.$2}) stopped the '
+        'replay budget at ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s).';
+  }
+  return AssistantMessage(
+    content: const [],
+    api: model.api,
+    provider: model.provider,
+    model: model.id,
+    usage: Usage.zero,
+    stopReason: StopReason.error,
+    errorMessage:
+        'Provider zero-byte stall after ${attemptLog.length} attempt(s) '
+        'over $elapsedText — the endpoint accepted the request but never '
+        'produced output; the run-idle watchdog killed every silent '
+        'attempt ($zeroByteStallTag). Attempts: $log. $windowNote To wait '
+        'longer on a warming-up model, raise '
+        'providerTimeouts.streamIdleTimeoutMs. The failure is '
+        'retryable: a fallback model may take over, or check the '
+        'provider status / try again later.',
+    timestamp: DateTime.now(),
+  );

# green — never a silent absence, never 35-40 min for an empty tick).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule
# runs are never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov
#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)
#   watchdog   → >2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out leg means a degraded
#                runner allocation → ONE empty-commit retrigger, never
#                `gh run rerun` (a rerun reallocates into the same pool)
#   release-pending → gh-1551 empty-tick short-circuit: the schedule is
#                the release arming mechanism (gh-1537), but a tick with
#                no commits since the last v* tag skips the whole gate

#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)

#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule
# runs are never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov

concurrency:

  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov
#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)
#   watchdog   → >2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out leg means a degraded
#                runner allocation → ONE empty-commit retrigger, never
#                `gh run rerun` (a rerun reallocates into the same pool)
#   release-pending → gh-1551 empty-tick short-circuit: the schedule is

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov
#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)
#   watchdog   → >2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out leg means a degraded
#                runner allocation → ONE empty-commit retrigger, never
#                `gh run rerun` (a rerun reallocates into the same pool)
#   release-pending → gh-1551 empty-tick short-circuit: the schedule is
#                the release arming mechanism (gh-1537), but a tick with
#                no commits since the last v* tag skips the whole gate

#               is the only macOS test surface)

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Tag/schedule

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Issue #177 — a pull request pays only for what it touched:
#   changes  → path classification (union semantics, shared files = full gate)
#   static   → size guard + analyze + publish dry-run        (always, ~1-2 min)
#   test-core→ dart test sharded ×4 (file-level units), per-shard coverage
#              + junit durations (core/shared)
#   coverage-gate → merge shard coverage; PR: diff-coverage, main: full ratchet
#   guards   → CRAP + jscpd + cross-module dupx              (core/shared/app)
#   flutter-analyze → flutter_app analyze on ubuntu          (app/core/shared)
#   flutter-tests → flutter_app tests sharded ×2 on ubuntu   (app/core/shared;
#                   golden suite stays in build-macos.yml — goldens are
#                   host-locked, see issue #177 E5 discussion)
#   flutter-app-exzone → JS-engine exclusion-zone tests on macOS (issue
#               #1267 N1; PATH-TRIGGERED on pull_request events and SM
#               validation dispatches alike — the changes classifier
#               derives the validated diff via merge-base(origin/main,
#               HEAD) under dispatch-only CI; gh-1538 retired the
#               nightly full-suite macOS backstop, so this pre-merge leg
#               is the only macOS test surface)
#   flutter-app-lock-smoke → linux+windows flutter_app RELEASE builds,
#               run only when the diff modifies flutter_app/pubspec.lock
#               (issue #1267 N2; same path-triggered model — PRs not
#               touching the lockfile pay nothing)
#   test-faui → packages/fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by manifest   (app/core/shared;
#               issue #283 — same template as test-core: manifest assert,
#               per-shard coverage merged to ONE report, junit durations
#               feed shard-rebalance.yml; goldens excluded as before)
#   faui-coverage → merge the 3 fa_ui shard reports into ONE lcov
#                   (issue #283 E3: the gate never sees 3 competing uploads)
#   quality-gate → ONE aggregate required check (skip-tolerant)
#   step-timings → per-step duration telemetry (jobs API → summary+artifact)
#   watchdog   → >2x-baseline timeouts; a timed-out leg means a degraded
#                runner allocation → ONE empty-commit retrigger, never
#                `gh run rerun` (a rerun reallocates into the same pool)
#   release-pending → gh-1551 empty-tick short-circuit: the schedule is
